title: Bounded flat proper cohomology model
statement: Let f:X→T be proper and finitely presented [def-pc-morphism-conventions], and F a finitely presented module flat over T. For every t∈T there exist an affine open U containing t, d∈ℕ and a quasi-coherent complex C of O_U-modules [def-pc-derived-category] vanishing outside [0,d], with every term flat over U, whose ordinary pullback computes every higher direct image after every cartesian base change to U. Moreover the ring complex of global sections Γ(U,C) is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex].

proof.text:
Choose an affine neighbourhood of t. Its proper inverse image has a finite affine
cover. Separatedness makes nonempty finite intersections affine. Form the alternating
complex of sections of F over these intersections and associate sheaves on the affine
base. It is bounded in [0,d], quasi-coherent, and flat over the base by relative flatness
and the affine local criterion for flatness. After affine base change its terms tensor
with the new base ring and still form the alternating section complex of the pulled-back
cover. Affine quasi-coherent acyclicity and Čech comparison compute higher direct images.
These identifications glue on affine opens of arbitrary new bases. Transport through the
unique isomorphism to a standard fibre product gives the assertion for every cartesian
square. Noetherian approximation of (f,F), proper coherence at the Noetherian stage,
and derived base change show that the ring complex of sections is pseudo-coherent.
Empty inverse images give the zero complex; no lower bound on fibre dimension is
needed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_proper_flat_cohomology_model {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (t : T) : ∃ (U : T.Opens) (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ), t ∈ U ∧ IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ C.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧ (letI : CommRing (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) := inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)); letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤))); DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (.op ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C))) ∧ ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T') [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q ≅ (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))
